tools.name: landed-receipt-checker
tools.description: A timeout is not a verdict, and 4 of 5 apparent write failures have already landed, so resending duplicates payments and posts. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Stores a durable write-outcome receipt (planned, sent, landed, landed_altered, failed, or unknown) keyed by your namespace and op_key
